purpose: Reject specified motion-to-image or visibility contracts on a finite controlled grid; no aggregate simulator credibility score.

render_contract.coordinate_convention: camera x right, y down, z forward; point coordinates in metres; pixel centres at x+0.5,y+0.5
render_contract.paired_renders: Identical background, camera, geometry and state; only both marker colours differ. No auto exposure, resize, noise or tone mapping changes.
render_contract.unsupported_adapter: A simulator unable to implement this marker/camera contract is unqualified for this suite, not thereby globally untrustworthy.

measurement.scope: Qualified paired-contrast synthetic marker widths only. This is not an ordinary vehicle or driving safety threshold.
